reference: The implications of US government export controls on our ability to ship products to China-based customers are significant. The AI Diffusion IFR, published in January 2025, proposed a worldwide licensing requirement for our data center products, which would have created a complex licensing approval scheme. However, in August 2025, the USG granted licenses allowing us to ship certain H20 products to specific China-based customers, generating approximately $60 million in revenue. Additionally, in February 2026, a license was granted for shipping small amounts of H200 products to select China-based customers, indicating a nuanced approach to export controls despite the overarching restrictions.
